paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.53b.11), but Hyman says this is a scribal error and that it should read R' Yoshiyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked text has Rabbi Oshaya permitting the practice, and Rava rules accordingly.
Hyman calls Oshaya a scribal error and proposes Yoshiyah. The linked passage retains Oshaya.
